method: Exact normalized section-token match (family + base number; subsections stripped; ranges expanded up to 60). Old-code tokens are folded to their new-code canonical ONLY via the site's own SECTION_EQ map already in index.html; the folded old tokens are listed in 'equivalents'. Tokens with no identifiable family (judgement 'SEC n' tokens and similar) are excluded, never guessed.
note_id_format: <subject>:<index> into notes.json arrays, e.g. bnss:0 = notes.json bnss[0].
judgment_id_format: Exact caseName from judgements.json (the site's existing join key, as used by its bench/cites overlays).
